title: JOVRA Studio shared definitions
description: Definitions shared by every JOVRA Studio record. Not a document type. No $id: references resolve relative to this folder. provenanceStatus mirrors spec/schemas/common.schema.json exactly; scripts/spec/validate_studio.py fails if they drift.

id.description: Opaque identifier. Letters, digits, '_' and '-' only, so an id can never be a path, URL or command.

templateId.description: A catalog template or preset id (card.goal, label.replay, warm-court-1). Never free text.

revision.description: Monotonic document revision. A newer revision makes plans and films bound to an older one stale.

dateTime.description: RFC 3339 timestamp in UTC with a Z suffix.

sample.description: True for fictional demo data, which every surface badges 'Sample'.

environment.description: Local demo (no network, tokens, uploads or charges), isolated test backend, or live backend.

fps.description: Exact frame rate num/den, e.g. 30/1 or 30000/1001.

rate.description: Clock rate as an exact rational (session seconds per source second). den is 1000000000, so the rate is held to 1 part per billion.

rationalTime.description: A time on a media clock: value / timescale seconds. Used for original PTS so variable-frame-rate originals can be rebuilt.

intervalUs.description: Half-open interval [startUs, endUs) in integer microseconds.

frameWindow.description: Half-open window [inFrame, outFrame) of render-proxy frames.

positionMm.description: Court coordinates in integer millimetres: x across the court (0 on the centre line), y along it (0 at the net, negative towards the near/primary end), z height above the court surface.

placementSlot.description: Build-your-match placements (screen 22): 1 near baseline (primary), 2 far baseline, 3-6 corners; custom for an imported or freely placed angle.

provenanceStatus.description: How a value was produced (ADR-0004). Must equal spec/schemas/common.schema.json#/$defs/provenanceStatus.

producer.description: Who produced a value: the user, a coach, a capability model, a deterministic rule, an import or the sample generator.

audioRoute.description: Bed routes in EDL v2. music and narration are separate optional lanes.

speed.description: Allowed playback speeds: 1 for live and B-roll; 1/2, 1/4, 1/8 for labelled replays.

credits.description: Studio Credits, the unit of quote, cap, reservation and receipt. Integer only.

userText.description: Text a person typed. Rendered as text, never interpreted.
